verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a cap-table SaaS platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers migrating into Qapita (from Pulley) and producing audit or compliance reports. Nothing documents a bulk export of all user data in open formats or an exit path, and audit-ready reports are an adjacent feature, not full data portability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
